chunks.en: We're looking for a new supplier.
accept: We are looking for a new supplier.
chunks.note: 跟廠商說明來意時用。We're looking for… 是「我們在找……」。

distractors.text: We're looking for new supplier.
We're looking a new supplier.
We're look for a new supplier.

chunks.en: Could you send us a quote for these items?
chunks.zh: 這幾個品項可以請你報價給我們嗎？
chunks.note: 請廠商報價時說。quote 是報價單，these items 指手上清單的品項。

distractors.text: Could you send us a quote for these item?
Could you send us quote for these items?
Could you send to us a quote for these items?

chunks.en: What's the minimum order for that price?
chunks.zh: 這個價格最少要訂多少？
accept: What is the minimum order for that price?
chunks.note: 廠商報了單價後，問最少要訂多少才有這個價錢。

distractors.text: What's the minimum order for that prize?
What's minimum order for that price?
What the minimum order for that price?

chunks.en: Is there a discount if we order five hundred?
chunks.zh: 如果我們訂五百個，有折扣嗎？
accept: Is there a discount if we order 500?
chunks.note: 問訂多一點能不能便宜。Is there…? 問「有沒有……」。

distractors.text: Is there discount if we order five hundred?
Is there a discount if we order five hundreds?
There is a discount if we order five hundred?

chunks.en: We need them by the middle of April.
chunks.zh: 我們四月中以前要拿到貨。
chunks.note: by＋時間：最晚在那個時間以前（截止日），不是「一直到」。

distractors.text: We need them until the middle of April.
We need them by middle of April.
We need it them by the middle of April.

chunks.en: Can you get them to us within fourteen days?
chunks.zh: 十四天內可以送到我們這裡嗎？
accept: Can you get them to us within 14 days?
chunks.note: within＋一段時間：在這段時間之內。問交期用。

distractors.text: Can you get them to us within fourteen day?
Can you get them us within fourteen days?
Can you get them to us until fourteen days?

chunks.en: This price is good until the end of March.
chunks.zh: 這個價格到三月底都有效。
chunks.note: 說報價的有效期限。good 在這裡是「有效」，until 是「一直到」。

distractors.text: This price is good until end of March.
This price good until the end of March.
This price is good within the end of March.

chunks.en: Could you do any better on the price?
chunks.zh: 價格可以再優惠一點嗎？
chunks.note: 客氣地請對方降價。do better on the price 是殺價常用說法。

distractors.text: Could you do any good on the price?
Could you do any better on price?
Could you any better on the price?

chunks.en: Let me check with Ms. Carter and get back to you.
chunks.zh: 我先問一下 Ms. Carter，再回覆你。
accept: Let me check with Ms Carter and get back to you.
chunks.note: 自己不能決定時說。get back to you 是「之後再回覆你」。

distractors.text: Let me check with Ms. Carter and get back you.
Let me to check with Ms. Carter and get back to you.
Let me check Ms. Carter with and get back to you.

chunks.en: We'd like to go ahead with the order.
chunks.zh: 我們決定下這張訂單了。
accept: We would like to go ahead with the order.
chunks.note: 名詞和動詞：the 後面的 order 是名詞（訂單）；order 也能當動詞（訂購）。

distractors.text: We'd like go ahead with the order.
We'd like to go ahead with the ordering.
We'd like to go ahead the order.

chunks.en: When can you confirm the delivery date?
chunks.zh: 交貨日期什麼時候可以確認？
chunks.note: 名詞和動詞：confirm 是動詞（確認）；delivery 是名詞（交貨），動詞是 deliver。

distractors.text: When can you confirmation the delivery date?
When can you confirm the deliver date?
When you can confirm the delivery date?

chunks.en: They can only deliver half the order on time.
chunks.zh: 他們只有一半的貨能準時交。
accept: They can only deliver half of the order on time.
chunks.note: 跟主管回報廠商延誤時說。on time 是「準時」。

distractors.text: They can only delivers half the order on time.
They can only deliver half the order in the time.
They only can deliver half the order on time.

chunks.en: I think there's a mistake on the invoice.
chunks.zh: 這張發票好像有地方寫錯了。
accept: I think there is a mistake on the invoice.
chunks.note: 發現請款單有錯時，用 I think 開頭說得比較客氣。

distractors.text: I think there's mistake on the invoice.
I think there's a mistake on the invoise.
I think there are a mistake on the invoice.

chunks.en: We'll send the payment by the end of the week.
accept: We will send the payment by the end of the week.
chunks.note: 答應付款的期限。by the end of the week：最晚這週結束前。

distractors.text: We'll send the pay by the end of the week.
We'll send the payment by end of the week.
We'll sending the payment by the end of the week.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, I'm Jack from Brightway. Nice to meet you.
scene.zh: 嗨，我是 Brightway 的 Jack，很高興認識你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks for having me. So, how can I help?
scene.zh: 謝謝你們請我過來。那麼，有什麼我可以幫忙的？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We're looking for a new supplier.
scene.zh: 我們在找新的供應商。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. I visit a lot of firms around here.
scene.zh: 太好了。這附近很多公司我都有在拜訪。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I brought a sample of our glass desk lamp.
scene.zh: 我帶了我們玻璃桌燈的樣品來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Is there anything in particular you want to purchase?
scene.zh: 你們有沒有特別想採購什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you send us a quote for these items?
scene.zh: 這幾個品項可以請你報價給我們嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure, no problem. I'll email it to you this week.
scene.zh: 當然，沒問題。我這禮拜會用 email 寄給你。

tasks.title: 單價、最低訂購量和折扣

fills.en: Last week, Jack ___ us a sample.
fills.zh: 上禮拜 Jack 拿了樣品給我們。
fills.note: last week 是過去，用過去式 brought。

fills.en: Is there a ___ if we order five hundred?
fills.zh: 如果我們訂五百個，有折扣嗎？
fills.note: 訂多一點想便宜，問的是折扣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, this is our standard lamp. It's sixteen dollars per unit.
scene.zh: 這是我們的標準款，一盞十六塊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the large one is nineteen.
scene.zh: 大款的是十九塊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What's the minimum order for that price?
scene.zh: 這個價格最少要訂多少？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Two hundred units. On average, firms order about three hundred.
scene.zh: 兩百盞。一般公司平均大概訂三百盞。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is there a discount if we order five hundred?
scene.zh: 如果我們訂五百個，有折扣嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, not at five hundred. Discounts start at a thousand.
scene.zh: 抱歉，五百個沒有。折扣要一千個才有。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But it's all in the quote, so have a look.
scene.zh: 不過報價單上都有寫，你可以看一下。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, when do you need the lamps?
scene.zh: 那你們什麼時候要拿到燈？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We need them by the middle of April.
scene.zh: 我們四月中以前要拿到貨。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. Let me check our availability for April.
scene.zh: 好。我查一下我們四月的供貨狀況。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good news. We have enough for your order.
scene.zh: 好消息，你們要的量我們有。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can you get them to us within fourteen days?
scene.zh: 十四天內可以送到我們這裡嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Most likely, yes. Our process usually takes about fourteen days.
scene.zh: 應該可以。我們的流程通常大概十四天。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: In a busy period, it can take eighteen.
scene.zh: 旺季的時候可能要十八天。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll give you the exact date when you order.
scene.zh: 你們下單的時候，我會給你確切的日期。

passages.title: Your quote from Brightway
lines: It was good to visit your office on Monday. Here is our quote.
Unit price: $19 ($16 for the standard size)
Discount: 5% on orders of 1,000 units or more
Delivery: Approximately 14 days. We guarantee delivery within 18 days.
There is an additional charge if you need a specific delivery date.
Payment terms: Within 30 days of delivery
This quote is good until March 31. Our terms and conditions are attached.

questions.zh: 這份報價什麼時候到期？

questions.en: When is there an additional charge?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I just read Jack's quote. It looks pretty good.
scene.zh: 我剛看完 Jack 的報價，看起來滿不錯的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The total value is $9,500 for five hundred units.
scene.zh: 五百盞，總金額九千五百塊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do we have to decide today?
scene.zh: 我們今天就得決定嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This price is good until the end of March.
scene.zh: 這個價格到三月底都有效。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great, then we have some time. When do we need the lamps?
scene.zh: 很好，那我們還有一點時間。燈什麼時候要到？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We need them by the middle of April.
scene.zh: 我們四月中以前要拿到貨。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. They guarantee delivery within eighteen days, so that works.
scene.zh: 好。他們保證十八天內交貨，這樣來得及。

lines.en: I just talked to Jack on the phone about the large lamp.
lines.zh: 我剛跟 Jack 通電話，談大款燈的價錢。

lines.en: Good. Was he willing to negotiate?
Yes. He can cut it to seventeen dollars if we order five hundred.
lines.zh: 願意。如果我們訂五百盞，他可以降到十七塊。

lines.en: Why not lower? Did he say?
lines.zh: 為什麼不能再低？他有說嗎？

lines.en: He said the cost of glass rose a lot this year.
lines.zh: 他說今年玻璃的成本漲了很多。

lines.en: Okay. Seventeen is fine. We can afford that, and the lamps are worth it.
lines.zh: 好，十七塊可以。我們負擔得起，那些燈也值這個價。

questions.en: What will one large lamp cost?
questions.zh: 一盞大款的燈會是多少錢？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, Jack speaking. Thanks for calling about the quote.
scene.zh: 喂，我是 Jack。謝謝你打來談報價的事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, what did you think of it?
scene.zh: 那你覺得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you do any better on the price?
scene.zh: 價格可以再優惠一點嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well, the cost of glass rose a lot this year.
scene.zh: 嗯，今年玻璃的成本漲了很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nineteen dollars is already a reasonable price for the large lamp.
scene.zh: 大款賣十九塊已經很合理了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But for five hundred, I can cut it to seventeen.
scene.zh: 不過訂五百盞的話，我可以降到十七塊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's a really good deal for you.
scene.zh: 這價錢真的很划算啦。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me check with Ms. Carter and get back to you.
scene.zh: 我先問一下 Ms. Carter，再回覆你。

textFills.title: Your order from Brightway
lines: Thank you for selecting Brightway. This email is the ___ of your order: 500 large glass desk lamps.
As in our agreement, the price is $17 per unit, a ___ of $2.
Our manufacturer will start production next week. ___
zh: 謝謝你們選擇 Brightway。這封信是你們訂單的確認：大款玻璃桌燈 500 盞。
照我們的約定，單價是 17 美元，降了 2 美元。
我們的製造商下週開始生產，4 月 14 日前會把燈送到。

blanks.note: 單價從 19 降到 17，是降幅 reduction。

options: We will deliver the lamps by April 14.
The price will rise next month.
blanks.note: 開始生產之後，接著說什麼時候交貨。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Thanks for calling back so fast.
scene.zh: 嗨！謝謝你這麼快就回電。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, did you talk to Ms. Carter?
scene.zh: 那你跟 Ms. Carter 談過了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We'd like to go ahead with the order.
scene.zh: 我們決定下這張訂單了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great! Five hundred large lamps, with the price reduction that we agreed on.
scene.zh: 太好了！大款五百盞，照我們談好的降價。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll tell the manufacturer today, and production starts next week.
scene.zh: 我今天就通知製造商，下禮拜開始生產。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When can you confirm the delivery date?
scene.zh: 交貨日期什麼時候可以確認？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: By Friday, they'll tell me how fast they can produce them.
scene.zh: 他們禮拜五前會告訴我多快能做好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then I'll email you a confirmation with the exact date.
scene.zh: 然後我會寄確認信給你，上面有確切的日期。

lines.en: Hi, it's Jack from Brightway. Sorry, but I have some bad news.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是 Brightway 的 Jack。抱歉，有個壞消息。

lines.en: There's going to be a delay with your order.
Our manufacturer exports to a lot of countries now, and demand has increased significantly this month.
lines.zh: 我們的製造商現在出口到很多國家，這個月需求大幅增加。

lines.en: The volume of orders is very high.
It's also partly because the imported glass came late. We've found an alternative source.
lines.zh: 有一部分也是因為進口的玻璃晚到了。我們已經找到別的貨源。

lines.en: We can deliver two hundred and fifty lamps by April 14, and the rest by April 19.
lines.zh: 四月十四日前可以先交兩百五十盞，剩下的四月十九日前交。

lines.en: Please call me back when you can. Thanks.
lines.zh: 方便的時候請回電給我，謝謝。

questions.en: How many lamps will come by April 14?
questions.zh: 四月十四日前會到幾盞燈？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Any news about the Brightway order?
scene.zh: Brightway 那張訂單有消息嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: They can only deliver half the order on time.
scene.zh: 他們只有一半的貨能準時交。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's not good. Remind me, when do we need them?
scene.zh: 這不太妙。我再確認一下，我們什麼時候要拿到？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We need them by the middle of April.
scene.zh: 我們四月中以前要拿到貨。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. Half on time is better than nothing.
scene.zh: 好吧。有一半準時到，總比都沒有好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's not look for an alternative supplier yet.
scene.zh: 先不要找別的供應商。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Call Jack back and get the exact date for the rest.
scene.zh: 回電給 Jack，問清楚剩下的貨確切哪天到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, Jack speaking. Thanks for calling.
scene.zh: 喂，我是 Jack。謝謝你打來。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think there's a mistake on the invoice.
scene.zh: 這張發票好像有地方寫錯了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Really? Let me check the transaction. Yes, it says $9,500.
scene.zh: 真的嗎？我查一下這筆交易。對，上面寫九千五百塊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, we calculated it with the old price. You only owe $8,500.
scene.zh: 抱歉，我們用舊的價錢算了。你們只要付八千五百塊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll send you a new invoice today. When can you pay?
scene.zh: 我今天會寄新的發票給你。你們什麼時候可以付款？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We'll send the payment by the end of the week.
scene.zh: 我們這禮拜內會付款。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Once Ms. Carter authorizes it, email the proof of payment directly to me.
scene.zh: 好。等 Ms. Carter 核准之後，把付款證明直接寄給我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi again! So, how did the last order go?
scene.zh: 嗨，又見面了！上一張訂單還順利嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think there's a mistake on the invoice.
scene.zh: 這張發票好像有地方寫錯了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry about that. I'll send you a new one today.
scene.zh: 真抱歉。我今天會寄一張新的給你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, Ms. Carter says you need more lamps?
scene.zh: 對了，Ms. Carter 說你們還要再訂燈？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you send us a quote for these items?
scene.zh: 這幾個品項可以請你報價給我們嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Our standard lamps are still sixteen dollars per unit.
scene.zh: 沒問題。我們的標準款還是一盞十六塊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is there a discount if we order five hundred?
scene.zh: 如果我們訂五百個，有折扣嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: For five hundred, I can do fifteen dollars.
scene.zh: 訂五百盞的話，我可以算你十五塊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you do any better on the price?
scene.zh: 價格可以再優惠一點嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, that's my best deal. It's good until the end of March.
scene.zh: 抱歉，這已經是最好的價錢了，到三月底都有效。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can you get them to us within fourteen days?
scene.zh: 十四天內可以送到我們這裡嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can send half in fourteen days and the rest a week later.
scene.zh: 十四天內我可以先送一半，剩下的晚一個禮拜。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, Jack. Sorry I'm late. So, how's it going?
scene.zh: 嗨，Jack。抱歉我來晚了。談得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: They can only deliver half the order on time.
scene.zh: 他們只有一半的貨能準時交。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's okay. The rest can come later. Do we have to decide today?
scene.zh: 沒關係，剩下的晚點到也行。我們今天就得決定嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This price is good until the end of March.
scene.zh: 這個價格到三月底都有效。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fifteen dollars is a fair price. Let's not wait.
scene.zh: 十五塊是公道的價錢，不用等了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We'd like to go ahead with the order.
scene.zh: 我們決定下這張訂單了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great! I'll send you the confirmation today.
scene.zh: 太好了！我今天就把確認信寄給你。
